messages.subject: managing multiple UI Outputs
parts:
My shiny app has a tabPanel element (below) in a navbarMenu, with two Outputs.

I seek to clear (i.e., default ui screen in shiny app)  the 2nd output (plotOutput("plotXXX")) when the  actionButton (GetInfoOnInputButton) is clicked for the first output (htmlOutput("infoOnInput")).
Otherwise the plot output does not correspond to the textInput.

Any ideas how to do this?   Thank you!

tabPanel(....,
  sidebarLayout(
   sidebarPanel(
     wellPanel(textInput(......),
               actionButton("GetInfoOnInputButton", 'Check Input') ),
  
     wellPanel(sliderInput(.....),
               radioButtons(.....),
               actionButton("GetPlotButton", 'Get XXX Plot')   ) ),
  
   mainPanel(htmlOutput("infoOnInput"),
                   plotOutput("plotXXX")  )       ))
